text: Buggy, cheap, pay to play. Same tired rubbish in a different skin. Play for half an hour and have a thousand "please give us stupid amounts of money for digital tokens worth LITERALLY NOTHING. Get to chapter 14. what happens? "build 2 of x building" except, there's not 2 plots with this building spawned in. So the game hits a dead end. Nothing else to be done. Its one redeeming quality was that I did not see a single advert. But don't waste your time. The grift never ends.

Wanted to play the game in the adverts I've been subjected to several hundred times, but it's not that. After one level like that I'm stuck in a completely different type of game with no idea how to proceed. I wish game advertisers would be more honest in their adverts. People who want the type of game this actually is, won't be attracted by the adverts. People, like me, who liked the gameplay in the adverts will be disappointed.

Extremely buggy. Every other update the game stops working completely and just won't load, and then a few days later and a new update and then it will load again. Happens every few days. Rinse and repeat. This time it's been 5 days and the last update didn't fix it. I'd be extremely annoyed if I'd spent money on it instead of just time.

From the copious ads you see for this game, you'd think it's some sort of rolling combat game. While there is a small element of that in it, it's marginal, access to it is limited, and was probably included to make the game look more interesting. No wonder- this is a very, very boring game indeed. It's a low-octane sim, with repetitive tasks and little reward. I don't know what type of person this would appeal to. Moreover you won't progress in this game if you're not willing to buy add-ons.

the ad looked fun, but the game makes painting a 100ft by 200ft fence with a toothbrush sound less like a waste of time than the hour I spent playing, absolutely awful. "one extra man added to the lineup" but it's just not there, ever, no customization and not even a menu to adjust the audio or anything. and the crystal collection has reset 4 times now, complete waste of time

Initially it was fun. But..... you reach a certain level and suddenly the game is designed to make you spend money on speed ups rather than wait 39 days !!!! for a building to finish upgrading ! But by FAR the worst thing is when you've reached General level 18 you are attacked by other players with levels of over 200 on a DAILY basis Causing you to waste your resources trying to revive and recover from the attack, only to be attacked again. Lost patience and uninstalled it.

barely a game. The running and shooting bits are fun, but very easy. However, 99% of it is a pay to play 'city building' thing which involves no skill or strategy. All the buildings are in predetermined locations and you just farm and upgrade them. lots of things to click on for little dopamine hit 'rewards', but it's all pre-determined. Battles have no strategy, and you don't even get to see the battles, just the end result. Get to level 9 and you have to pay to progress

It's a shame I am having to give this a 1 star. Like many other people,I agree that the start of the game is great. You play levels that usually are usually only on the ads of games. It's fun and challenging in places, but once you hit level 20, it just becomes impossible without spending money. I bought the starter pack, and that ran out very quickly. The fun side games disappear as well, so it becomes a waiting game for resources.

As many have said, it's fun at first, but you soon hit the point where you are forced to spend actual £££ if you want to progress. Once you start levelling up then it all gets more costly in terms of resources and Valor Points etc, but harder to farm those things at the same rate, so the game becomes unplayable unless you spend money. Great concept but left feeling like I'm a sales target for the developers rather than a player.

Initially I enjoyed the game, but found the game was no longer playable after a certain level, without spending money. My biggest gripe was when a few days ago I was asked to update and lost my game. The game wouldn't restart once I upgraded, so I unistalled, finding when I reinstalled it was impossible to login with my old details. I am annoyed/disappointed at having reached over 1 million in power points, paying £ into the game, and at not receiving any reply to my email to the support team.

Absolute shhttt. First levels are fine. I only really liked the small side games, not the general game. You have to hit certain points to get to the higher levels of the shooting game, but they are near on impossible after a couple of hours unless you pay for the items. Just feels like a massive waste of time, and money if you are willing to spend it.

Slow to load, then resumes loading on the Pay to Play page, then you can finally play. Wouldn't be so bad if it didn't make you load again and again. To start with it's ok but within a couple days playing free, the game is such a slog it has lost all elements of fun. At level 28 or so you now have to upgrade the Capitol and Academy to level 9 needing 260,000 of each material to do so. The only fun part is the the mini games, which you barely do any after a few days. Don't waste your time.

ads are definitely misleading. the shooting part shown in the ads is a small part of the game. no ads which is great but it's going to end up being a game that's pay to play. game is okay, I highly recommend avoiding the missions in the tower. managed to make it to level five on the tower and I can't advance. you can't beat it, it's set up so you fail every time. game is okay but don't see myself keeping it.

I did enjoy this game BUT you can't progress without putting down real cash, which I did 3 times! Even then you quickly run out of resources and the wait time to build is ridiculous. Mining 100k of anything takes several hours and is spent in one upgrade! Simply put, it gets very boring very quickly after level 15 and I'm simply not paying out continously just to play the same game. Very disappointed as it's only enjoyable if the game progresses at a reasonable rate, then it's soooooo slow.

Really fun at first with little to no waiting time so you're constantly playing. But you're getting nowhere as it just gets repetitive to gather resources, revive your soldiers, etc. A lot of time is spent waiting as you can't do any actions. I know it's now the business model of these games on apps, in an endless loop . But for me it's just become time wasting of my life; it was good for a couple of days, could have paid for it even, but thank you and goodbye.

This game starts off good after a few hours you see it not what it seems. This is a building game, and resources take time to build up. The next thing is that you can be raided or attacked by players bigger than yourself. I had to rebuild my army only to be attacked again by another player. When you log on, it is the store page and adds as you play down the side. After a week I deleted the game as I not going to spend money. There is no way this game is fair when a much hight player can attack.

There is a lot about it that is above and beyond the others. However, by around level 8 of my main character, I got absolutely sick and tired of repetition, upgrading, repetition, more repetition without any genuine sense of progress. It was just the same thing over and over but with bigger numbers. Nothing more. So I got REALLY tired REALLY quickly (only my 2nd day). May as well uninstall

Genuinely, what is this? Get a few levels then gate kept out till you complete linear missions. Gives a decent amount of resources at start, or so it seems. I upgraded some of my town because that seemed to be how to progress, do another level and I need to spend 1,000 lumber for a mandatory upgrade you can't play without. problem is I'm on 200 lumber, I generate 90 lumber AN HOUR and there's a 7 hour timer for some character. the math doesn't math, awful game, no gameplay after 3 missions

same old rubbish. ads show a game. The game starts that way for about 5 mins of play. then it just turns into another build a town hall, build a homestead, build a lumber mill, upgrade town hall, collect rocks, upgrade lumber mill repeat, repeat, repeat, repeat. just dull. of course does the usual thing of getting to the point where it takes a while day for upgrades to complete unless you drop a couple of hundred £$ on in app purchased. don't bother waste of time shame you can't give 0 star

Its ok, but not at all as advertised, which i find objectional. 'Dont always reflect' is a joke. I continue to see adverts for totalbattle featuring what amounts to a totally different game. Totalbattle is a very limited game where you built up a city almost identically to other players where you form clans to compete for resources. It is absolutely not a puzzle game or an open island growth/adventure game. The adverts are verging on illegally misrepresentative. Needs irl cash to compete.

Starts out looking a little like those line-runner advertisements, but rapidly degrades into those awful city-builders where you either need to pay for resources to be able to play the barely existent line-runner "fun" gameplay. The actual interactive parts of playing this game aren't fun and are barely consequencial, if you fail a stage you can simply skip. Skip this game instead, it is once AGAIN "the game in the ad that's not like it appeared at all when you play it." Total garbage.

Up to something dodgy. Whatever this claims to be, it isn't. it's a newly skinned variant of what is becoming a tired genre. The actual battle mechanics drew me to it and I'm fairness are enjoyable, if depressingly easy for anyone who paid attention in maths. the problem however is that it slows a very capable device to a crawl and generates a lot of heat. it's clearly doing more than just playing the game. uninstalling after review. suggest others do the same.

Describing this game as "pay to win" would be massively incorrect. It it "pay to play". Even getting to use the most basic interface features that are completely free in every single other game that I tried require you to pay money. Don't even get me started on the level progression. Want to get to the top without paying? 200 years. I did the math.

First it's not what is advertised, because for you to fight you have to build staff and upgrade things to be able to play, but they advise fighting and you will have to do 10 things before to be able to fight. they could put infinite fights to get up or something else, for you to play while you have to wait for things, instead of that I just close the game till next day because you can't do anything.

This is a good game. But its updates on data should be automatic and not required for me to install through Google Play. No other gaming apps I have installed in the past have required it, and this is the first I have come across that does. Otherwise it's entertaining with a moderate story, and I like the battle engine involved that is good for battlefield games on the mobile. That allows you to take a more direct approach in coordinating troops, than issuing commands.

I'd give 5 stars BUT I am absolutely infuriated that I cannot find where to turn the sound off. It shouldn't be that hard! Settings should be on the main menu, not buried somewhere. So I can't play this game unless my volume is all the way down on my phone, which means I can't listen to podcasts while I play. Please fix this!! Once you do. I'll give 5 stars.

This game suuuucks. The ads show a vertically scrolling third person shooter and that minigame is kinda fun. But when you download it turns out that's a small part of the game and you can't play it whenever you want. Most of the game is the most boring resource management game you'll ever see and it constantly tries to get you to pay to play. Complete waste of time.

Three stars for being close to the ads. So many games are straight up lies these days. You will get to shoot things down a pathway. But the game also has a city building aspect that I am just tired of. Plus now I've beaten all the Lvl 1 rounds of battles and basically have to pay to continue. No thanks. Uninstalling. I would have preferred all battles with ads and no city building.

Game nicely done overall, runs smoothly wo issues. The thing that made me to uninstall the game was the game forcing you to buy items in order to avoid eternity to upgrade/proceed with the game. I would suggest smaller fees/packages or even optional adds with transparent info how it works (or to explain the user that he/shhe doesn't have to pay 5euros 20times per day.

Captivating! Normally I wouldn't download these types of games but I was like wth, just dl and delete anyway. I gave the game a shot and now I'm glued to my phone (I'm not sure that's a good thing), but after CODM I'd vote this second. I'm screwed at the same time because my screen time also increased with this game. All I can say is "the game is super addictive." I just hope the developers can give us more free items and reduce item prices as well. I'd give it a 5 star when I see better prices.

it turns into pay to progress after you reach captain level 9. I'm not paying for anything. I'm deleting. To be clear, you can play after level 9, but it will be very very slow progress. what I could have done in 1 day, now takes about a week. After I log in I run out of tasks in about 5-10 mins and have to wait until tomorrow or longer for the next step. where as before, I could play for an hour or so a day.

A very well designed game that is both relatively simple to learn and very addictive. Incredibly detailed with impressively crafted missions and monsters. Success is dependent on teamwork through a clan with other players worldwide. Not great if you want a shooting game. Great if you have plenty of time for the game. This is primarily a "build your kingdom" game, with a minimal secondary "shooting game" aspect used as a method of winning items.

Game has the potential to be very fun. but be prepared to spend money on in app purchases or else you'll be stuck. Even if willing to spend money on in app purchases the system still allows cheating. The one safeguard against scripts they had, portal march time 30 seconds minimum, was rolled back and discontinued. It's turned into a joke, ill find something else to play.

very frustrating city builder. I keep getting stuck with trying to figure out what the game wants me to do and getting stuff to complete something once I do figure it out. currently I need supplies to build a forge. the only stage it gives me for the items, I haven't been able to beat. after a few losses I get a pop up to buy some characters. I'm still in early chapter 3. If I wanted a soulsborne game I would have looked for one.

I have lost access to my previous account after I uninstalled and then reinstalled the Total Battle app on my tablet. Scorewarriors have been so slow in reply if at all despite frequent requests to support team. I have been out of my account for nearly 4 days. I never imagined the reinstalling the app would be such a complicated process! and I am finding it quite annoying in fact!

This entire platform is a cleverly designed scam. They lure you in with false advertising, let you play for free, and then start flashing sales in your face and then corner you by slowing your progress down. There are "strong" players that can come in and wipe out everything you've paid for, which are just developers using gaming accounts to bully and push you into spending more. If you're playing, check your bank account, they charged me multiple times for purchases and won't refund.

After hero level 7 this game is strictly paid to win. Also, I attacked an elven citadel which, didn't tell me it's strength level on the icon and I lost My whole army. And now I don't have the coins or sacred potions to get them back. I will have to pay for them. So, I struggled to level 8 and now I run out of wood stone and silver. This means I can't upgrade any buildings. Also, I haven't played the game in a few months and when I logged back in my army was deleted by the game.

This game is fun in the beginning when you can actually afford to build things and it doesn't take a TON of time, but after that it's excruciating. the devs are constantly finding ways to make processes take longer and suck the fun out of the game. I would only play this game if you plan on spending hundreds of dollars on it. even then, it's redundant. you spend so much time training troops and reviving them just to send them to their death again. it's impossible to get enough loot from crypts.

It wants your money badly! I have a general rule that if the first thing an application you install does upon running is show a full screen of sales ranging from a few bucks to exorbitant prices, you avoid it like the plague! This is one of those games, typically you must pay and pay to have any chance of making progress based on your abilities and not your wallet.

The ads for this game are misleading. You only get to play that game for a very small portion, then it becomes more about building your city. It often gets attacked by others at way higher levels that you are helpless to avoid. I dont understand why what was advertised, the shooting soldiers part, can not be added or continued. I am at level 26 and I am about ready to stop playing. I have made some purchases and it seems like you almost need to buy things to really progress.

Pay2Play, but even when you pay, you don't play much. It's basically just a point and click — you click on a monster, send troops to attack, done. You click on a resource, send troops to mine or explore, done. None of this is interactive, you just click to go and that's it. Community is okay, depends on the Kingdom, clan system is nice. Support doesn't help as it should, if at all. Cannot be played offline or with bad connection. AI "art" throughout.

The ad shows a side game which is only a small part of the game. The rest is building a city, fighting monsters and other players, and can either take forever, or cost an arm and a leg... and maybe a few other body parts as well. It's designed for big spenders to win, so be prepared to sell body parts, or spend countless hours collecting resources only to have them taken by players who have been around for much longer, and or players who spend big.

This is my first time playing an online mobile game and I must say, Total Battle is truly immersive! It covers both competitive and cooperative aspects of RPG gaming. I am especially impressed with the translator which completely removes the boundaries between people of different nations, it even translates some slang and gamer lingo! For once, I am truly grateful to the annoying ad from a certain app that couldn't be skipped until I opened this game's install page on Play Store. Thank you!

played tens of hours.. unexpectitly monster-encounters , that the game play relies on, difficulty quadrubled and the game became unplayable. only option would be to restart everything and replay the forced storyline through again.. it was somewhat acceptable on the first time.. second time felt like agony so i quit the game. accessing other apps.. minute to restart and click three sales notification away EACH time.

I was so wrong about this game. It starts off great and is a lot of fun. But after awhile your Kingdom gets "opened" and you learn what the game is truly about. It's about Money players who have been around longer then you, and who are therefore stronger, attacking you repeatedly and bullying you into not even enjoying it anymore. So all the money you spend in game eventually was just throw away because the Devs have placed no restrictions on PvP and the disparity in might. DONT DOWNLOAD

this is classic bait and switch. if there were an option for no stars, that's what I would have given it. This is not really a shooting game, it's a city building game. most of the 50 million people who downloaded this game probably downloaded because they thought it was a shooting game. after you shoot down enemies for a little while, that's when they switch it and let you know that it's some stupid world building boring game. if you wanted a shooting game, don't waste your time.

1 star because expensive, they spend more time on graphics for their youtube videos than the actual game, NO SELECTING/SELECT ALL/DELETE ALL BUTTON YET for army, hard to get enough tar and monster coins once you grow to a substantial size, should be able to see a pop-up if there is a call for a raid or an incoming attack while in the menu the way they easily say someone helped you speed something up, among other things!! So much work needs to be done.

I want to play the game advertised, not the endless maze of trinkets, you didn't advertise building houses and scrolling through a maze map of unwanted strategy just to point aim and shoot. (pac man) was brilliant due to its simplicity also Tetris. If Pac Man or Tetris tried to reinvent the wheel by adding too much fluff strategy and endless monetization, they would have not dominated. the actual game play is fun but the fluff in between lost me.

A game for those with a waterfall of income. Misleading ads to say the least. Quite unethical. Anyways, the two stars are for the story line and the video game design. It would be far much better if the app had an upfront cost and maybe tiny extras thereafter than to have it look like some gambling gaming room.

last week for 3 and 1/2 days I was unable to log in and do anything on the game cuz it kept on crashing. I contacted support and I don't know if they did anything or not but it started working a lot faster after the 3 and 1/2 days. Going on the second week it is now acting up again and now I am on 1 1/2 days in and is taking a lot longer to load up, then when it fully loads up it goes back to crashing. I have bought packages through the game and cannot get the full experience/ money worth.

Reasonably fun for the first 48 hours. Then your free premium buff for being a noob runs out and the real game shows itself. Things go from taking seconds to taking hours. From costing a few resources per unit to hundreds. There are extremely few ways to earn the limiting resources for building and upgrading so no reason to keep playing. This needs to change if you expect free players to stick around and be the content for your whales.

I spent a lot of time progressing to G9. After all that hard work, Seasonal Kingdom forces players to start from zero again for important rewards like mythic captains. It feels more like a waste of time than a fun event. The game has good strategy elements, but the constant grind, pressure, and fear of missing rewards make it stressful instead of enjoyable. Keeping up with events requires an unhealthy amount of time,money and effort. its completely killed my motivation to continue playing.

somewhat entertaining at first, starts to get expensive if you want it to stay interesting. the first 3 or 4 levels are ok... it's kingdom building... the line battles like in the ads are fun but theyre only 3% of gameplay. as you go higher in levels the plays take longer, sometimes days. you can buy $peed-ups of course. likely: you'll play to about level 8, spend about $10-20 buying speed boosters, then realize this game will quickly start to cost you the equivalent of a car lease. next.

Please Admin Team, I don't think seasonal kingdom is for every player because players who can't buy gold passes and forest passes are always being attacked by those with high might points. Although it's not a problem for those who can play with money, It's not easy to play for those who don't have money. I don't think they should just give people who can afford to pay money to do whatever they want.

They recently made a change to make it almost impossible to get mercenaries without spending real money so I've decided to not spend any money at all anymore until they fix it. Now they've quit even selling $5 mercenary packages so I'm quitting the game. You're not improving Total Battle, you're destroying it. So now Total Battle doubles down on excuses by saying you can play for free totally ignoring that they've made it significantly more difficult even for paying customers. I'm done with it.

A big part of this game is Seasonal Kingdom where you can progress very quickly and end up with a truly powerful account... unfortunately constant bugs, glitches and unresolved issues have destroyed my latest SK (Seasonal Kingdom). Really poor support which is a true shame as I really loved to play this game.

Not the game in the ad. It takes you into a city where it tells you to click on buildings and click on keys etc for no apparent reason, then you get stuck without knowing why, and there is no further play. Waste of time.

I love the game. However if I'm already a player with an account, there should be an option to directly log in when I install the game on another device. I shouldn't have to go through the redundant gameplay that usually happens for beginners. Please fix that

If it could just be about the battles and not all this other nonsense, I'd enjoy it a lot more. I want battles—not all the upgrade stuff and everything else. It's confusing, takes the fun out of it, and there are way too many ads.

Really like this game. it's quite expansive and there's a lot you can do and it's not boring and the mini games are fun. if you want to do the shooting part there is a temple for that and there's a side quest that repeats. oh yeah, no ads! and it doesn't crash all the time. if you like rpgs and board games you'll prolly like this one. I do wish that you could sell your surplus supplies for either gold or silver coins- that's it. pretty fun.

too many problems with this game has defeat level 9 rare monster 1 time I have fought and waa successful 5 times defeating it and it still never gives me the credit for completing and it stays stuck with that on my main city board and wont let me go to my next job assignment im sick and tired wasting my time doong what it says it does me no good to keep destroying the level 9 rare monster cuz it never credits me for it and keeps me stuck on that task why dont you have report problem menu in game

Its fun after a day it becomes a pay 2 play mainly to level up and the army dies so thats more money or spend days to try get half your army revived not counting you have to have scrolls to level up each building to level 10+. so yup this is a cash grab game.

I am needing assistance in restoring my account. Sent an email with all my information. But haven't received a response. I definitely need help! I worked hard on that account. I love the game. I think support is just slow.

Redownloaded app, can't get past the first screen. In an endless loop of nonsense trying to figure out how to fix a ships steering wheel. I have spent money on this game, but now cant get back to my accounts to play anymore.

gameplay stalls around level 8 unless you pay. overcomplicated game so they can monetize every aspect of the game and make you buy items in game. otherwise they make you suffer by waiting for level ups.

After 2 years of constant playing (and spending a ridiculous amount of time and money) I deleted the game. The repetition of challenges and events became mind numbing and issues raised with support always takes days to be answered (never resolved though, you just get some gold and a lame response). If making other people very rich is your thing, this game is for you. If you're not going to spend, spend, spend you won't get anywhere.
Battles are fun, if a bit easy, but there's so much extra faffing about you have to do to get to the battles, it's such a waste of time. Another misleading advert.

The game is fun and addictive, but it has some major issues. First, the strongest captains are locked behind paywalls. Second, progression is extremely difficult at the beginning, though it becomes easier once you get stronger. Finally, event rewards are far too small compared to the costs of training troops and reviving dead units. Overall, it's an enjoyable game, but it heavily favors paying players.

Super fun game. It involves those shoot em up number games but it's so much more than that. Once you start following the city instructions and discover the outside world and clans you will get hooked. You do not need to pay to play, either, though a few of my clan mates do. Highly recommended if you want a game with endless things you can do and discover.

The gameplay displayed in the ads is fake. The real game is much more boring, it's all about buying upgrades, making you wait and inviting you to spend real life money if you don't want to be blocked from progressing in the game. Don't install it!

Ever since this recent update, i have been unable to login. i even unistalled and installed again but its moving too slow and refusing to let me restore my progress. please fix this because i was really enjoying the game and have invested a lot already

I am needing unfortunately, to edit my initial review. when I played before I believe I was in k170, im now in k290 and I hate it. we are stuck in battle groups with rumors of the inability to be fully opened. so we are stuck with only 3 other kingdoms we can visit and thats it. it is also rumored that support has issued a statement that if you dont like it, to just leave to another kingdom. I have grown a family within my clan and its simply too expensive to change to another kingdom.

Total Battle is an aggressive example of pay-to-win design and excessive monetisation. Progression is heavily slowed to encourage spending, and staying competitive can quickly become expensive. Recovering from attacks often requires additional resources, creating a cycle that pushes players toward repeated purchases. The game relies heavily on FOMO, artificial scarcity, and psychological pressure rather than rewarding strategy, skill, or long-term dedication.

So the Add it showed that interested me in playing the game where you shoot the team and stuff and that was only for a short time and I wish they would add more levels to play more of those games in it. I do like the interactive parts of it but I wish there was more immediate games that you can play. Again they only had them for a short time.

typical pay to win game which is fine. However, if you have any issue or problem with the game and losing or not receiving paid for items, they will do NOTHING to help you except give you the typical thank you for the feedback and basically tell you to kick rocks. All the income they make and they won't help you, they are borderline CROOKS. Basically have to dispute the charges and for that they will ban your account. If you check various other sites they have horrible customer support ratings.

great game except for the occasional glitch. For example: I reached beyond stage 10 in the expedition and was NOT rewarded with the meat to feed my baby dragon. I would love to contact game support. However, I don't know how. So, with the glitches and failure to let players know how to contact support, I give 3 stars.

unless you're well off financially, I'd stay away from this game. Its too expensive. especially as you level up the game becomes more and more expensive with basically no ways to earn the "gold" needed to revive troops. Only way to revive is gold, only way to play is revive. Then there's the time it takes to revive. you need speed ups unless you want to wait 7 or more days for one type of troop at a time. Its just not worth the money you have to spend for the game to be enjoyable.

The game is interesting but... there are no clear instructions on how to play. For example in the daily rewards you have to combine an enchantment. Well I have no idea how to do that and when you tap the "i" it just says the same thing.. well ok where do I go, what do I do, how do I know if I even can? So it would be helpful to have an area in the game for new people to learn. Sometimes you just want to drop in and out of a games and not spend hours trying to find one thing.

A lot of advertisement that doesn't even look like the actual game. You can't really do much in the game without spending ridiculous amounts of $$$. UPD (re comment from devs): "Active" clans require quotas to meat, that requires at least $50 every 5 days to get the Mercenaries for the "Big Clan Event", and at least $20 for the gold pass every month. On top of it clans have to use 3party *PAID* tools because game doesn't provide almost no tools to track member progress properly.

this game really let me down. it was fun at first then I got to a point where couldn't increase my army nor my property without spending tons of real money. what was advertised of what to expect from the game after downloading it was all the complete opposite! don't waste your time

started off so strong was a pretty fun game until you realize that its just like the rest pay in order to win and its just a waiting game I lose interest so fast when everything is an ad or have to wait just to upgrade a building. thought it was going to be different. they make it just about impossible to level up your characters im stuck on level 10 and cant unlock the dragon bc they made it to where you have to pay to win. I wouldnt waste my time on it

So they decided to add two part authentication of course in their fashion. they've completely screwed it up. I have to continuously every time go through two-part authentication even though I'm on a system that I've used forever. so now when the game crashes I got to try to log in go through your stupid two-part authentication which is a real pain when it's crashed multiple times and you got to figure out which email is the latest and correct email to enter the code number from and their support

This game is MUCH more than just the swipey monster killing part. Lol. This game includes teamwork. You will meet people from all over the world and work on building a strong team as well as your individual character in real time. I'm hooked.

The recent change to Portal attack march speed in the middle of Seasonal Kingdom is complete nonsense. You don't make a major gameplay change halfway through a season when players have already built their strategies around existing mechanics. Portal attacks have been a critical part of SK strategy, and many players invested time, effort, and money based on how the game worked when the season started. Slowing portal attacks fundamentally changes gameplay and invalidates established strategies.

I was looking for a brain teasing game, not one where I have to build buildings and manage resources. The game does look good if that's what you are looking for, sadly I was not.

When you start, the game gives you some new player buffs that make it playable and fun. After the first 2 or 3 days, you lose these buffs, and the game-play crawls to a halt and becomes *very* grind-y and very much 'pay to win'. The purchase options are very, very expensive, and if you buy one of the lower cost packs, then all the low-cost pack options disappear, leaving you nothing but the extremely costly options.

This game could have been so fun. The advantage players get by paying, though, is significant. Also, the amount of losses incurred after a battle and the cost to sustain an army is ridiculous. Even if it predicts a 0-2% loss, it almost always turns out to be more losses than the battle itself was worth, which makes it make no sense. Not a worthy game as is
